title: Lesson 8 - That's Not What I Meant

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I thought you were taking care of the living room.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I did. I vacuumed, put the books away, and cleaned the coffee table.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: It looks great, but that's not what I meant. We still need places for six people to sit.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Oh. I thought “take care of the living room” meant clean it.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's fair. Maybe I wasn't clear. What I meant was, could you set up the room for everyone?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: So, are you saying we need two more chairs?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Exactly. Do we have any folding chairs in the closet?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: We have one. I can bring in a chair from the desk, too.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That gives us six. Would you mind moving those boxes away from the window?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Who's supposed to pick up the food—you or me?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Me. You don't have to do that. Let me put it another way: you set up the room and put the drinks in the fridge, and I'll pick up the food.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Sorry, I misunderstood. I thought I was picking up the food and you were getting the drinks.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Then my first message really wasn't clear.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Let me make sure I've got this right. I need to set up six seats, move the boxes, and put some water in the fridge. You're picking up the food.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Right. We only need a little ice, so I'll get that on my way back.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Good. I'll write it on the list this time.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Please do. “Take care of it” is not much of a list.
